Thanks for the draft. A couple of finance comments:

1) The 16% headline for 3yr is acceptable conditionally, but any tiered refund/rollover softer than our standard 12mo policy requires CFO sign-off.
2) If Orchid requests split billing (quarterly invoices against the prepay), we can support it but need a credit_line hold and a $25k admin fee; commercial must document in SOW.
3) For a 3yr upfront we recommend adding a performance SLA credit structure (0.5% credits per missed SLO up to 3%) to mitigate risk.

I'll approve the pricing range internally (16% max), but exceptions to rollover/refund or split billing need a finance approval ticket. Ben — please confirm whether Orchid explicitly asked for split billing or refunds in any of the RFP language.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance| Redwood Inference
